plugins.description: Adds skills for git repository analysis — contributor activity over custom time periods, code ownership and bus factor per area, PR/review collaboration via the gh API, and contributor impact/churn analysis.

plugins.name: content-author
plugins.description: Adds skills for writing and editing readable text in English and German — readability indices, plain language, sentence craft, structure, German-specific pitfalls, and revision workflow.

plugins.name: notion-summarizer
plugins.description: Adds skills for turning long sources — books, courses, documentation, reports, article series — into a structured Notion summary: a detail page with filled properties and cover, one styled subpage per chapter, and a flashcard page for spaced-repetition tools.

plugins.name: agentic-coding
plugins.description: Adds four unattended agents (planner, coder, reviewer, janitor) and 16 skills for an AI-native ticket-to-merge loop on Jira, GitHub Issues or Notion — intent and spec artifacts, contract-first implementation, skeptical review, guardrails, evals, closing-the-loop monitoring, metrics and harness tuning.
